summary: Learn prompt design, evaluation, and AI workflow control in 5 days. Build practical templates and a reusable prompt library.
lede: Prompt engineering for business professionals involves designing and testing prompts to produce useful, consistent AI-assisted business outputs. It helps business users specify roles, context, constraints, and success criteria, then compare prompt variants and check outputs for accuracy and tone. The course also covers reusable prompt libraries and practical patterns for writing, analysis support, and internal knowledge retrieval, without requiring learners to become developers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already use digital tools at work and now need dependable AI prompt design skills for business use.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in business communication, reporting, or process-based roles and be comfortable using modern web-based AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude. No coding is required, although familiarity with spreadsheets, document workflows, and basic data handling will help you get more value from the exercises. A laptop with a current browser is required for hands-on prompting labs, and participants should bring examples of recurring business tasks, templates, or reports from their own work where prompt engineering for business professionals can be applied immediately.
